assumptions.choice: First order's limit price set to the current bar's close (self.data.close[0])
assumptions.reason: Spec requires a Limit Buy Order but states no price level; the latest close is used as a neutral, immediately-actionable reference price.

assumptions.choice: Both order sizes computed as pct * self.broker.getvalue() (total portfolio value), converted to whole shares at the current close
assumptions.reason: Spec defines sizes as % of 'total trading capital'; getvalue() (cash+positions) is the standard measure of total capital in backtrader.

assumptions.choice: The 10:00-16:00 time-window filter is implemented literally by comparing self.data.datetime.datetime(0).hour/minute against the configured bounds
assumptions.reason: The feed is daily OHLCV with a fixed time-of-day on every bar (no true intraday timestamps or session data), so as written this filter will not admit any bar in the supplied dataset; this is the closest literal reading given the missing intraday information.

assumptions.choice: 'Total risk' for the combined position is computed as the sum of the two position size percentages (notional exposure as a fraction of total capital) and gated against max_total_risk_pct before any order is placed; the parameter defaults are taken directly from the spec's own examples (50% + 50% sizing vs. a 1% risk cap) without alteration
assumptions.reason: No stop-loss/exit mechanism is defined anywhere in the spec, so true monetary risk (entry-to-stop distance x size) cannot be computed; notional exposure fraction is the closest computable proxy from available inputs. The spec's own example numbers are mutually exclusive, so this gate will block all trading under the stated defaults.

assumptions.choice: Sufficient free balance is checked as self.broker.getcash() >= (first_size+second_size)*current_close before the limit order is submitted
assumptions.reason: Approximates the total cost of both orders using the current close as a fill-price proxy, since actual fill prices for orders not yet executed are unknown.
